sql:
SELECT AVG(t.Consumption) / 12 AS AvgMonthlyConsumption
FROM yearmonth t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND t.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
